dedupe_keys.name: sniamb portuguese national environmental information system

description: SNIAmb (Portuguese national environmental information system) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Portuguese Environment Agency (APA). The portal groups environmental information under climate, water, air and noise, waste, environmental assessment and risk prevention; the water section carries the river-basin management plans of the third cycle and the flood risk management plans for 2022 to 2027, and there are map viewers, a coastal resources system and a metadata catalogue. Coverage: Portugal, including coastal areas. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated on the page. Caveats: the page names no download formats, web services or licence, so it is catalogued as an access point whose layers may be served elsewhere; only part of the content concerns infrastructure. It can support flood and coastal risk context for water, road and rail assets in Portugal. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
